market_summary: Across all 6 monitored assets, markets are entering late New York session / cash close consolidation. Gold and Silver are compressing in tight ranges below their respective VWAPs, EURUSD and GBPUSD are completely flatlining at their EMA20 baselines and session POCs on sub-0.5 RVOL, US100 has stabilized above EMA50 but faces immediate EMA20 resistance mid-channel, and BTCUSD is drifting toward Session Low support without volume confirmation. With all instruments trapped mid-channel or hovering at session support without yellow RVOL breakout expansion, capital preservation dictates a universal HOLD across the board.
